style_rules: Write as original English prose, not as a literal transfer of source-language syntax.
Prefer lean, idiomatic English verbs over abstract nominal constructions.
Split long source-language sentences when English rhythm benefits from shorter sentences.
Keep AI and software terms in standard industry English unless the source contains a deliberate localism.
For metaphor-heavy passages, preserve the effect and tension of the image rather than the exact source image.
naturalness_gate: Reject any sentence that sounds like a calque from the source language.
Reject word order that is grammatical but not idiomatic in English.
Reject overly formal phrasing when the surrounding article uses essayistic or literary tech-blog prose.
Reject literal idiom translations unless the same idiom exists naturally in English.
notes: Expand this glossary after real Serbian-to-English translation work exposes recurring decisions.
